Frame Interpolator Frame number 150-533 Duration (milliseconds) 400 OK Cancel AND YOU CAN EVEN TEST THAN TRYING TO FREEHAND YOUR PIXEL ART ANIMATIONS.","key_claims":["Animation is one of the hardest things in game development, especially for pixel art games","The creator's early Game Jam animations for Isidore's Edge from about 3 years ago were extremely rough","The game's animations have improved tremendously since a collaborator named Fur joined the team","A technique called a 'blockout' can make pixel art animation much easier","The natural instinct for beginners is to animate frame by frame directly with detailed art, which is slow and hard to fix","A blockout assigns a distinct flat color to each body part so poses are easy to read without detail","Animating with blockout color blobs is faster and easier than working with detailed sprites","Blockouts let you preview and test the overall motion in-game before investing time in detail work","Problems with motion are easier to fix when working with simple blockout shapes","Once a blockout animation is finalized, adding detail to each pose is much easier than freehanding a detailed pose from scratch"],"info_channel":"spoken"}
